source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.20 with Figs. 9.33 to 9.35 (PDF 222-223).

blocks.text: Thermistor heat sensitive (garmi mehsoos karne wala) resistor hai. Zyada tar thermistors ka temperature coefficient negative (manfi) hota hai, yani temperature barhne par un ki resistance kam hoti hai. Positive (musbat) temperature coefficient wale thermistors bhi milte hain.

blocks.alt: Thermistor ki do symbols (nishan). Baen: oval khaake mein zigzag resistor, us par tirchha teer oopar baen ki taraf. Daen: dono taraf taaron wala mustateel, us ke aar paar tirchhi lakeer jo neeche baen chhote horizontal (ufuqi) pair par khatam hoti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.33: thermistor ki symbols (kitab ki Figure 9.33 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Thermistor mein temperature barhne par resistance kyun ghatti hai? Kyun ke barhta temperature charge carriers (electrons ya holes) ko zyada energy deta hai; woh zyada azaadi se chal sakte hain, is liye resistance kam ho jati hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Metal (dhaat) mein garmi se resistance barhti hai kyun ke collisions (takkar) barhte hain. Thermistor semiconductor hai: garmi se naye free carriers bante hain, aur un ki barhi number (ginti) ka asar zyada hota hai, is liye resistance ghatti hai.

Thermistors manganese, nickel, cobalt, copper, iron waghaira ke metallic oxides ke mixture se bane semiconductor ceramic ko zyada pressure mein garam kar ke banaye jate hain. Inhein desired (chahi hui) shapes mein daba kar zyada temperature par pakaya (bake kiya) jata hai. Thermistors mukhtalif qism ke hote hain; yeh beads (daane), rods (salakhen) ya washers ki shakal mein hote hain.
